pages.text: OreSpawn is back. The legendary mod of rubies, dinosaurs and extremely questionable life choices now runs through this whole pack — its ores seeded across every world, its monsters loose in every biome, its titans waiting at the end of it all.$(p)This guide is your map through the chaos. Read it before the chaos reads you.

pages.title: Staying Alive
pages.text: $(li)Build real walls. Much of what's out there digs, flies, or spits.$(li)Watch for buried spawn blocks — ancient dried eggs that hatch when disturbed, and treasure to those who mine around them.$(li)Do not slap the $(l:orespawn_integrations:bestiary/girlfriend)Girlfriend$().$(li)Do not wake $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/mobzilla)Mobzilla$(). Especially not Mobzilla.

pages.title: The Road Up
pages.text: Start with $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/ruby)Ruby$() gear, then forge the Ultimate line from $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/uranium)Uranium$() and $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/titanium)Titanium$(). $(l:orespawn_integrations:ores_gems/tigers_eye)Tiger's Eye$() waits in another world entirely.$(p)Royal and Queen tier gear cannot be mined or bought. It is torn from the $(l:orespawn_integrations:bosses/the_king)crowned things$() in this book's final chapters.
